rzs_rights.decision: Selected public aggregate statistics may be reused with source, retrieval date and modifications identified; no resource-specific restriction was found in the selected captures.

geometry_policy: No new municipal polygons or guessed geography. Tables preserve the captured territorial IDs; geographic expansion requires a verified crosswalk.

held_candidates.title: Verified historical air archive
held_candidates.limitation: Workbook units, station identity, revisions and product rights require validation.

held_candidates.title: Belgrade scheduled transport
held_candidates.limitation: Two Belgrade feeds; calendar, duplicate stops and product rights require validation. Schedules are not live vehicle positions.

held_candidates.title: Annual road traffic counts
held_candidates.limitation: Reuse decision and road-section geometry unresolved; Serbian/English editions overlap.

held_candidates.title: Captured preliminary hourly air history
held_candidates.limitation: Deduplication, clock corrections and station continuity required before long-term baselines.

held_candidates.title: Historical pollen
held_candidates.limitation: Validate Belgrade locations, species, periods and rights; other cities occur in the capture.

held_candidates.title: Annual reported emissions
held_candidates.limitation: Facility identity, units and rights; emissions are not ambient concentration.

held_candidates.title: Education institutions
held_candidates.limitation: Public facility fields only; exclude personal contacts and validate location/edition.

held_candidates.title: Culture and heritage
held_candidates.limitation: Multi-city capture; geographic and rights qualification required.
